about.text: A goat’s-milk cheese from Sicily, about 3 kg, with an oily rind marked with the rush-basket pattern and a spicy taste. The curd is hand-pressed in rush baskets, scalded in hot whey, and salted the next day and one or two more times at ten-day intervals; it is ripened three to four months.

sources.text: The process, the size, and the Sicilian recognition and PAT status.
